_doc: Cast. Text lives in dialogue/<lang>.json keyed by line id; here only ids. lines: trigger -> [line ids] (one is picked at random). Triggers: greet, level_<n>, unlock:<id> (crop/recipe/building/animal/feature id), served, arrive. Guests also have favourite meals (weighted into their orders) and min_reputation before they visit.

innkeeper.name: Marigold Pennywhistle
innkeeper.backstory: Marigold inherited the old Harvest Inn from her grandmother along with a leaky roof and a ledger full of IOUs. She believes a warm bowl and a soft bed can fix most things, and the rest can be fixed with patience.
innkeeper.personality: Warm, organised, quietly funny; keeps a pencil behind her ear.

chef.name: Basil Okafor
chef.backstory: Basil cooked on river barges for twenty years and can make a feast from three turnips and a rumour. He came to the valley for one season and never left, mostly because of the tomatoes.
chef.personality: Booming, generous, dramatic about seasoning; hums while he works.

merchant.name: Wren Castellano
merchant.backstory: Wren runs the market stall and a very loud bell. She has cousins in every town on the trade road, which is how she knows the price of pumpkins three valleys over.
merchant.personality: Quick-talking, honest to a fault, loves a good bargain more than a good profit.

vet.name: Dr. Juniper Hale
vet.backstory: Juniper grew up on a dairy farm and studied animal care in the city. She came home to make sure every hen, cow, goat and sheep in the valley lives a long and spoiled life.
vet.personality: Gentle, practical, talks to animals in a special voice and is not embarrassed about it.

craftsperson.name: Rory Thistlewood
craftsperson.backstory: Rory built half the mills on the river and repaired the other half. They speak to machines more kindly than to most people, and the machines, frankly, behave better for it.
craftsperson.personality: Dry wit, careful hands, secretly sentimental about old tools.

guest_wanderer.name: Old Tobiah
guest_wanderer.backstory: Has walked every road in the kingdom and has a story about each of them, most of them true.
guest_wanderer.personality: Slow, kindly, always on his way somewhere.

guest_painter.name: Pip Lorne
guest_painter.backstory: Paints sunsets for a living and sunrises for fun.

guest_scholar.name: Professor Odalys
guest_scholar.backstory: Studying the valley's unusually cheerful sunflowers.
guest_scholar.personality: Precise, curious, tells you the Latin name of everything.

guest_cyclist.name: Zuri Fast
guest_cyclist.backstory: Delivers letters across the hills by bicycle; always hungry.

guest_musician.name: Lyra Bellweather
guest_musician.backstory: Plays at weddings, harvest dances and, if paid in pie, anywhere.

guest_baker_kid.name: Milo Crumb
guest_baker_kid.backstory: Ten years old, already very serious about bread.
guest_baker_kid.personality: Earnest, polite, takes notes on your crust.

guest_fisher.name: Captain Haddie
guest_fisher.backstory: Retired from the river but not from talking about it.
guest_fisher.personality: Gruff voice, soft heart, terrible jokes.

guest_gardener.name: Nana Yoon
guest_gardener.backstory: Has won the county pumpkin ribbon eleven times and judges yours silently.

guest_poet.name: Ash Verity
guest_poet.backstory: Writes a poem for every inn they stay at. Yours will be about soup.

guest_knitter.name: Granny Purl
guest_knitter.backstory: Knits on the coach, at dinner and possibly in her sleep.
guest_knitter.personality: Sweet, nosy, gives the best compliments.
